title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Observe the shape of the scatterplot. Does it resemble a linear, quadratic, or another type of function? This will help you determine the relationship between $$z$$ and $$y$$.

title: Identifying the Pattern
text: The scatterplot shows a curve that increases more steeply as $$z$$ increases. This suggests a polynomial relationship. Consider what kind of polynomial might fit this pattern.

title: Choosing the Correct Function
text: Based on the scatterplot, which function best represents the relationship between $$y$$ and $$z$$?
